supporting_observations.claim: The recurring HTTPS requests target updates.pixelforge-suite.com at 13:37:50, 13:42:31, 13:47:45, 13:53:13, 13:58:15, 14:02:29 and 14:07:46 UTC, consistent with the approximately five-minute update-check interval documented in the supplied inventory.

Endpoint records associate each recurring request with PID 5684, C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, connecting to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080. This matches the approved updater path in the supplied inventory.
The updater started with --background under NWD\leo.martins at medium integrity, with explorer.exe as its parent, and exited at 14:08:08 UTC.

Successful update-domain CONNECT tunnels each report 1,524 client-to-server bytes and 19,382 server-to-client bytes. The 13:42:31 attempt instead received a proxy authentication-required response (407), not a successful tunnel.
The matching approved destination, executable path and expected cadence support ordinary PixelForge update checks rather than a malicious finding for the alerted connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: Successful proxy records describe CONNECT tunnels and byte counts, not decrypted request or response contents; they do not establish what data was exchanged (T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00219).
The supplied updater process-creation records contain no executable hash or signature verification, so path attribution does not independently authenticate the binary (T046-00098, T046-00099).

The supplied recurring update-domain records cover 13:37:50–14:07:46 UTC; they do not independently substantiate connections throughout the alert's entire stated 13:30–14:10 interval (T046-00101, T046-00219).
claims_not_established: Command-and-control or exfiltration is not established by the recurring tunnel timing and byte counts (T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00219).
The exact encrypted payload and cryptographic authenticity of pfupdater.exe are not established (T046-00098, T046-00099, T046-00101).
unrelated_findings: Separately investigate sam.okafor's network logon to WS-SOKAFOR-01 from WS-LMARTINS-01 at 13:26:04 UTC. The source differs from the designated remote-administration workstation; these records do not establish what actions followed or connect it to the updater traffic (T046-00023, T046-00024).

Open a separate software-policy ticket for DropboxUpdate.exe running as SYSTEM on WS-LMARTINS-01, since Dropbox is outside the supplied approved services. Execution is shown, but file synchronization or exfiltration is not established (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00127).

Separately validate authorization for Slack.exe execution under leo.martins because Slack is not listed in the supplied approved software. A loaded Slack DLL has a valid Slack Technologies signature, but that does not establish organizational approval (T046-00187, T046-00188, T046-00189).
